hello.text: Bet I can clear more rats than you before supper. Go on. Bet.

t0.text: Something's walking about by the old barrow in the south fields. Dead things. Da says leave it. I say somebody ought to go and look, and it might as well be someone good.

t1.text: West, under the hills, where the trail turns south. Aunt Marta's place. We're not supposed to talk about Aunt Marta.
